jen: Heads-up — I ran the shrinkwrap build for the Private/VPC airgap bundle and noticed the image tag set includes the new runtime helper (runt-1.5.0) and the installer v2.0.0-rc.qa. We should decide whether to canary or pin to runt-1.4.x for the canary window.
omar: what's the risk? failing smoke or config drift?
sophia: smoke passed locally but the e2e in staging shows occasional startup timeouts on machines with older kernels (~3/10). logs show KV cache warm issue.
emily: can we hotfix with a startup flag for cache backoff? quick patch would be runt-1.5.0+flag.
jen: release-bot, what artifacts do we currently have signed for this bundle?
release-bot: artifact-index.json created at 2026-03-18T10:12Z. Signed images: installer:v2.0.0-rc.qa (cosign ok), runt:1.5.0 (cosign ok). No shrinkwrap provenance attached yet.
jen: ok — two paths: 1) abort canary, pin canary image to runt-1.4.9 (previous prod), rebuild shrinkwrap index and re-sign; or 2) proceed with canary for a small subset with a temp-startup-flag and monitor 1hr window.
omar: I'm leaning to option 2 if we can limit blast radius. We need a short canary window and an automatic rollback trigger on >5% error rate.
sophia: agree. I can create the pinset policy to route 10% of Private tenants in us-east to the new bundle. I'll also add the `--kv-cache-backoff=200` flag in the canary manifest.
emily: can we do that without re-building the airgap bundle? ideally just patch the runtime container args in the artifact index and cosign an attestation.
infra: cosign attestation for container args is ok, but our airgap installer reads the shrinkwrap provenance. If we don't rebuild the tar, it's messy for airgapped customers.
jen: decision: we'll do a staged canary (10% us-east) for 60 minutes with the patched startup flag. If errors spike, we'll immediately pin back to runt-1.4.9 and abort rollout. After canary completes, if stable, we produce a full shrinkwrap rebuild and sign the new bundle for private customers.
deploy-bot: Canary started: bundle=private-airgap:v2.0.0-rc.qa, variant=patched-startup-flag, scope=10% us-east, started_by=jen, ts=1793456800
sophia: monitoring hooks in place — dashboards updated, alert if 5xx > 5% or p95 latency > 2s.
omar: quick note: change window for full rebuild is set to 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow (low traffic). We should not block that unless canary fails.
emily: I pushed a temp index update pointing to runt:1.5.0+flag and added a cosign attestation entry. infra, can you confirm attestation is discoverable by our installer preflight?
infra: confirmed — preflight will fetch provenance from artifact-index and accept attestation if cosign sig present. For full airgap tar we still need to include the tarball contents in the shrinkwrap.
jen: good. If canary OK, assign follow-ups: 1) rebuild shrinkwrap tar + provenance + cosign sig (emily), 2) update release notes and private delivery manifest (sophia), 3) schedule full canary->rollout during 02:00-03:00 UTC (jen).
emily: noted. I'll kick off the shrinkwrap job after we give the all-clear. Command for reproducibility:```./scripts/shrinkwrap --bundle private-airgap:v2.0.0-rc.qa --include-provenance --out ./dist/airgap-v2.0.0-rc.tar.gz```
sophia: also adding a line to release notes about the pinned optional runtime flag and the rollback guard. Will include the image pinset table and cosign sig checksum.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: 15m check — error-rate 1.2%, p95 latency 1.1s, no crashes.
omar: looks healthy so far. Continue monitoring.
jen: recheck at 45m. If green, we proceed to plan for shrinkwrap rebuild in the change window.
deploy-bot: Canary ended (natural completion): 60m, final error-rate 0.9%, p95 1.0s, sessions OK.
jen: canary succeeded. Emily, please rebuild shrinkwrap and attach provenance + cosign sig; mark private delivery manifest as signed.
emily: starting shrinkwrap job now. ETA ~20m. Will output `provenance.json` and the cosign signature.
infra: after emily uploads, I'll run the artifact verification script:```./infra/verify_artifacts.sh dist/airgap-v2.0.0-rc.tar.gz```
sophia: I'll draft the private release notes and send to legal for export control checkbox.
jen: thanks team. Postmortem item: add an automated kernel compatibility smoke test to pre-prod so we catch kv-cache warm issues earlier. Adding to backlog. :white_check_mark: 
release-bot: Release candidate v2.0.0-rc.qa marked 'canary-passed' for private-airgap. Next state: 'awaiting-shrinkwrap-sign'
